title: Podcast Aggregator & Streamer Pro (.NET 8 / WPF / WinUI 3)
target_os: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64 Native Executable / Single-File Self-Contained .exe)
overview: A high-performance Windows desktop podcast management, RSS feed aggregator, and low-latency audio streaming workstation built with .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), NAudio / LibVLCSharp, CodeHollow.FeedReader, and SQLite / Entity Framework Core. Enables users to subscribe to RSS/Atom podcast feeds, parse embedded OPML podcast catalogs, stream audio with variable playback speeds (0.5x to 3.0x with pitch correction), navigate ID3v2/MP4 audio chapters, manage offline episode download queues, and execute non-blocking background feed syncs without UI thread freezing.
key_features: RSS/Atom Feed Parsing & OPML Catalog Manager: Fast asynchronous RSS/Atom XML feed parsing engine supporting podcast iTunes tags, episode artwork, enclosure media URL extraction, and 1-click OPML export/import

Low-Latency Streaming Engine & Variable Speed Control: High-fidelity audio playback pipeline via NAudio or LibVLCSharp with real-time pitch-preserved speed adjustment (0.5x to 3.0x), custom skip buttons (-10s / +30s), and position memory resume
Audio Chapter Marker & Metadata Inspector: Embedded ID3v2/MP4 chapter marker parser displaying active episode chapters, clickable jump points, episode show notes, and dynamic artwork rendering

Offline Episode Download Queue & Auto-Pruning Engine: Multi-threaded async download manager streaming episode MP3/AAC/M4A audio files directly to disk with configurable retention limits and storage usage caps

SQLite Local Storage & Asynchronous Feed Sync: Entity Framework Core / SQLite local database storing podcast subscriptions, listened progress flags, episode history, and background PeriodicTimer sync updates
Non-Blocking Asynchronous Telemetry & Mini Player: System.Threading.Channels passing playback timecodes, buffer progress, throughput metrics, and system tray mini-player updates directly to WPF UI

core_stack.gui_framework: WPF / WinUI 3 with Wpf.Ui (Fluent Dark Theme / Windows 11 Mica Glass Effects)
core_stack.audio_engine: NAudio (v2.2+) / LibVLCSharp (v3.9+) with pitch-preserving speed modifiers
core_stack.packaging: MSBuild / dotnet publish (PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true producing standalone ~45MB .exe)

design_system_and_theme.theme_name: Deep Espresso & Cyber Orange (Windows 11 Mica / Fluent Grid)

typography.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Display, Cascadia Code, Inter, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) with Async SQLite & Audio Stream Pipeline
system_architecture.ui_layer: WPF / WinUI 3 XAML markup with Wpf.Ui Fluent dark controls, podcast catalog sidebar, episode listing DataGrid, chapter navigation drawer, mini-player footer bar (-10s / +30s buttons), and OPML manager modal
system_architecture.background_services: Asynchronous PeriodicTimer background sync service polling subscribed RSS feeds, NAudio/LibVLC audio streaming worker threads, SQLite EF Core database writers, and episode download task workers
system_architecture.ipc_and_event_bus: System.Threading.Channels (Channel) streaming atomic playback position updates, episode download progress, and feed updates directly to ViewModel
system_architecture.process_safety: Strict unmanaged audio handle cleanup (IWavePlayer.Dispose(), AudioFileReader.Dispose()), database transaction thread safety, cancellation token handling on downloads, and safe temporary file cleanup

ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Media & Systems Software Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade native C# / .NET 8 desktop application titled 'Podcast Aggregator & Streamer Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-dependency, high-speed podcast player, RSS feed aggregator, and offline episode workstation using .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), NAudio / LibVLCSharp, CodeHollow.FeedReader, and SQLite. Enables users to parse RSS/Atom feeds, import OPML catalogs, stream podcasts with pitch-corrected variable speeds (0.5x to 3.0x), skip intervals (-10s / +30s), inspect audio chapters, download episodes for offline listening, and execute background DB syncs without UI thread freezing.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. .NET 8.0 ARCHITECTURE & MVVM PATTERN:
   - Built with C# 12 and .NET 8.0 LTS using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ([ObservableProperty], [RelayCommand]).
   - Styled using Wpf.Ui applying Fluent Dark theme tokens (#080608 background, #F97316 cyber orange primary accent, #A855F7 violet secondary accent) with Windows 11 Mica glass visual effects.

2. RSS/ATOM FEED ENGINE & SQLITE DATABASE:
   - Use CodeHollow.FeedReader to fetch and parse podcast feeds asynchronously, extracting iTunes author tags, episode artwork, and media enclosure URLs.
   - Store podcast channels, episode metadata, play progress timestamps, and listened status in a local SQLite database using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite.
   - Provide OPML import and export capabilities for importing podcast subscription catalogs.

3. AUDIO STREAMING & CHAPTER NAVIGATION ENGINE:
   - Implement low-latency audio streaming via NAudio or LibVLCSharp supporting real-time speed adjustments (0.5x to 3.0x) with pitch retention.
   - Provide quick skip buttons (-10s backward, +30s forward) and playback resume position tracking.
   - Parse embedded ID3v2/MP4 audio chapter markers and render clickable chapter jump points in the UI.

4. OFFLINE DOWNLOAD MANAGER & TELEMETRY:
   - Build an asynchronous episode download manager streaming audio files to target storage directories.
   - Stream atomic progress events, byte rates, and active playback timecodes using System.Threading.Channels without locking the main WPF UI thread.

5. SINGLE-FILE PACKAGING:
   - Deliver complete C# source files (MainWindow.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, PodcastFeedService.cs, AudioPlayerService.cs, DatabaseService.cs) and a ready-to-publish .csproj configured for PublishSingleFile=true self-contained .exe output.
